senses.en_definition: Specially provided or arranged for a particular purpose or recipient.
Special; out of the ordinary or particularly valued.
Especially; all the more; used to introduce a stronger or additional point.

messages.en: It's Mum's birthday tomorrow, right? I want to cook something special for her.
Just make rendang. You know how much Mum loves yours. I'll get the cake.
Deal. But don't tell Mum yet. Let's give her a little surprise.

senses.en_definition: A signal, gesture, or other sign used to convey a message.
Occult knowledge or supernatural arts (classical usage).

messages.en: I'm at the entrance already, but I can't see you. It's so crowded here.
I'm next to the ticket machine. If you spot me, give me a sign—put your hand up or something. I'm wearing a red shirt.
My laptop won't turn on. Have you got a number for someone in IT?
Yeah, I'll give you Hafiz's number. He handles laptop problems at our office.
Thanks! I'll drop him a quick message to ask when he can take a look.
Is the food at that place any good?
It's really good, bro. Their curry noodles are amazing.
